title: Separate what happened from what it means.
lead: An invented review note from a practice session. The wording distinguishes an observation, an interpretation, and a proposed next step.

categories.label: Observation
categories.description: A count from the session: six completions out of eight attempts.

categories.label: Interpretation
categories.description: A possible explanation, qualified by suggests and may.

categories.label: Next action
categories.description: A proposed comparison that could reveal more.

runs.text: Six of eight learners completed the task without a hint.
This suggests the opening example may have been useful.
Try the lesson again with a different opening example.

items.name: Observe
items.detail: Record the result that was actually seen.

items.name: Interpret
items.detail: Name a possible explanation with appropriate uncertainty.

items.name: Investigate
items.detail: Choose a next step that can challenge the explanation.

children.content: The count describes this fictional session. It does not establish that the opening example caused the result.
